# `max_line_length`

Column target for reflow. off disables reflow entirely and selects preservation mode.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `off` |  |
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `off`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").Append("World").Append("!").ToString();
    }
}
```

### `max_line_length = off`

```ini
max_line_length = off
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
